commands.allowedCommands.description: Commands that can be auto-executed when 'Always approve execute operations' is enabled
commands.deniedCommands.description: Command prefixes that will be automatically denied without asking for approval. In case of conflicts with allowed commands, the longest prefix match takes precedence. Add * to deny all commands.
commands.commandExecutionTimeout.descrip: Maximum time in seconds to wait for command execution to complete before timing out (0 = no timeout, 1-600s, default: 0s)
commands.commandTimeoutAllowlist.descrip: Command prefixes that are excluded from the command execution timeout. Commands matching these prefixes will run without timeout restrictions.
settings.execution.environment.descripti: Development environment route for commands. Auto selects PowerShell 7, WSL, MSVC, Android, or remote macOS when command semantics require it.
settings.execution.wslDistribution.descr: WSL2 distribution used for Linux, GCC, and Docker Engine commands. Leave empty for the default distribution.
settings.agent.fallbackProfiles.descript: Provider profiles tried in order when the task's model endpoint fails or its context overflows. The task resumes on the next profile.
settings.agent.askUserTimeoutSeconds.des: How long the agent waits for your answer to its question before it decides on its own and states its assumption. 0 waits indefinitely.
settings.agent.review.description: After a task that used tools, ask the same model (thinking off) to check the answer against the tool evidence once, and send the task back with one note when it finds a gap.
settings.agent.streamRules.description: Stream rules (regular expressions) that interrupt the agent and resume it with a correction. Leave empty to use the built-in rules.
settings.execution.dockerContext.descrip: Docker context used when the Docker route is selected explicitly.
settings.execution.msvcDevCmd.descriptio: Full path to the Visual Studio VsDevCmd.bat script used by the MSVC route.
settings.execution.macosRemoteHost.descr: SSH host for remote macOS/Xcode commands, for example builder@mac-host. No GitHub sign-in is required.
Prevent task completion when there are incomplete todos in the todo list
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.descripti: Settings for VSCode Language Model API
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.vendor.de: The VS Code language-model provider identifier (for example, local)
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.family.de: The family of the language model (e.g. gpt-4)
settings.customStoragePath.description: Custom storage path. Leave empty to use the default location. Supports absolute paths (e.g. 'D:\OctoCodeStorage')
settings.autoImportSettingsPath.descript: Path to a OctoCode configuration file to automatically import on extension startup. Supports absolute paths and paths relative to the home directory (e.g. '~/Documents/octocode-settings.json'). Leave empty to disable auto-import.
settings.maximumIndexedFilesForFileSearc: Maximum number of files to index for the @ file search feature. Higher values provide better search results in large projects but may use more memory. Default: 10,000.
settings.useAgentRules.description: Enable loading of AGENTS.md files for agent-specific rules (see https://agent-rules.org/)
settings.apiRequestTimeout.description: API response timeout (seconds, default: 600, range: 1–3600). Higher values are recommended for local providers. Unsupported providers: Amazon Bedrock, Google Gemini(directly or through the Vertex AI platform), Mistral, Moonshot, Ollama, Poe, VS Code LM API.
settings.newTaskRequireTodos.description: Require todos parameter when creating new tasks with the new_task tool
settings.codeIndex.embeddingBatchSize.de: The batch size for embedding operations during code indexing. Adjust this based on your API provider's limits. Default is 60.
settings.debug.description: Enable debug mode to show additional buttons for viewing API conversation history and UI messages as prettified JSON in temporary files.
settings.debugProxy.enabled.description: **Enable Debug Proxy** — Route all outbound network requests through a proxy for MITM debugging. Only active when running in debug mode (F5).
settings.debugProxy.serverUrl.descriptio: Proxy URL (e.g., `http://127.0.0.1:8888`). Only used when **Debug Proxy** is enabled.
settings.debugProxy.tlsInsecure.descript: Accept self-signed certificates from the proxy. **Required for MITM inspection.** ⚠️ Insecure — only use for local debugging.
settings.workspace.rootResolution.descri: How OctoCode resolves the workspace root in a multi-root workspace. The root is used to locate `.roomodes`, `.roo/mcp.json`, `.roo/rules/`, and other project-scoped configuration. Changing this setting only affects future lookups; running tasks keep their original root.
settings.workspace.rootResolution.active: Use the workspace folder containing the active editor; fall back to the first workspace folder. (Default — preserves legacy behavior.)
settings.workspace.rootResolution.firstF: Always use the first workspace folder (workspaceFolders[0]). Deterministic — independent of which file is currently focused.

command.recoverDesktopUpdate.title: Recover OctoCode with Full Installer
configuration.update.manifestUrl.descrip: Defaults to OctoCode private releases using your GitHub login. Custom HTTPS, loopback HTTP, and local file manifests are supported. Empty disables checks; only a manual check can request sign-in.
configuration.update.mode.manual: Only when you run the check command.
configuration.update.mode.start: Once each time the window opens, and on demand.
